subject: Acme — Reranking validation: NDCG/MRR results & A/B plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ethan.park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: Validate a reranking model to improve search relevance for Acme’s help center results (focus on NDCG@10 and MRR).
- Success metrics: +6–10% relative NDCG@10 improvement in offline evals and no downstream CTR regressions in the first A/B week.
- Data: You’ll share a feed of 50k query-result-label tuples (sampled recent queries) and an initial prompt set for relevance evaluation.
- Redwood recommendation (high level): run two candidate models — a tuned 7B reranker (quantized) and a 13B cross-encoder variant — compare NDCG/MRR, then run a 2-week A/B at 10% traffic if offline looks good.

Immediate next steps: 
1) Jordan: share the sample dataset + prompt_set_v1 by EOD Friday (21 Jul) — SFTP or Drive link ok.
2) Neha & Ethan: perform offline evals (NDCG/MRR) and produce a short playbook with evaluation configs.
3) Marissa: follow up with a one-page A/B rollout plan and timing.

I’ve attached a suggested playbook and a starter prompt set (prompt_set_v1.jsonl) to speed things up. We’ll kick off the offline run once we have your data.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments referenced: rerank_eval_playbook.pdf, prompt_set_v1.jsonl

From: Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Priya and I pulled the sample and uploaded it to the shared Drive folder (link below). We included labels for the top-3 results per query and a small holdout. Let us know if the format looks good.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFGhRerank

One quick Q: What's your recommend cadence for re-training the reranker if we see drift? Monthly-ish or on-demand after label accrual?

Jordan
Jordan Hughes
Head of Search Product | Acme Corp
jordan.hughes@acme.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ethan.park@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Thanks — I confirm we have access and the file looks good. Short answer on cadence: start with a monthly retrain cadence for the first 3 months while monitoring quality; move to event-driven retrains (label-driven) after stability. We’ll include a recommended retrain policy in the playbook.

Neha & Ethan — please start the offline evals using the two candidate configs we discussed:
- Candidate A: 7B tuned reranker (8-bit quant, batch infer)
- Candidate B: 13B cross-encoder (mixed precision)

Please keep detailed NDCG@10 and MRR@5 outputs at the query-segment level, and export the CSV. Jordan/Priya — expect initial results by Friday COB (24 Jul).

-Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Hi all —

We completed the initial offline runs against the sample (results attached). High-level: 

- Candidate A (7B reranker): NDCG@10 +8.1% relative vs baseline; MRR@5 +5.6%
- Candidate B (13B cross-encoder): NDCG@10 +9.8% relative; MRR@5 +7.3%

Notes: Candidate B shows stronger offline improvement but has ~2.4x higher per-request cost and ~30% higher p99 latency in our dev config. We also observed a small quality variance on long-tail query segments — flagged in the CSV.

Attached: acme_rerank_ndcg_mrr_results.csv (query-segment breakdown), and we pushed the run to the internal eval dashboard: https://redwood-internal/reports/eval-dashboard?run=2026-07-24

Next proposed step (recommended): if Acme is comfortable with the cost/latency delta, run Candidate B in a conservative A/B at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with automated rollback on negative CTR signal. Otherwise start with Candidate A at 10% and iterate.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Staff ML Engineer, Model Eval | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Thanks Neha — this looks promising. A couple quick clarifications before we proceed to A/B:

1) Can you quantify the expected unit cost delta (per-1000 requests) for Candidate B vs Candidate A? We need that for our procurement and runbook.
2) For the A/B plan, can you include the exact metrics and thresholds for automated rollback? We want something actionable (e.g., >1.5% negative CTR change sustained for 24h).

Also looping in David from infra to confirm we can route 10% traffic to a Redwood endpoint next week for the test window.

-Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme.com>, Jordan Hughes <jordan.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, ethan.park@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps — rerank validation (post-call)

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Attached is the one-page A/B rollout plan and the estimated cost delta for Candidate B vs Candidate A (summary below). Full numbers and configs are in the attached playbook and CSV.

Summary (estimates per 1,000 rerank requests):
- Candidate A (7B): $2.40 per 1k requests
- Candidate B (13B): $5.90 per 1k requests
- Delta: +$3.50 per 1k requests (Candidate B) — this includes GPU time and model hosting assumptions for a 99th percentile throughput scenario.

Suggested A/B rollout (we can kick off as soon as infra confirms routing):
- Traffic split: 90% baseline / 10% candidate
- Duration: 14 days
- Primary metrics: NDCG@10 (offline), CTR (online), successful click-through rate to articles, mean time-to-first-click.
- Automated rollback triggers:
  - Absolute CTR drop >1.5% sustained for 24 hours OR
  - Statistically significant negative change in click-through post-click conversion (p < 0.05) over a 48h window

David — can you confirm routing availability for a 10% split next week and any rate limits we should be aware of?

Next human step: Jordan/Priya to confirm which candidate to run (A or B) and sign off on the rollback thresholds. We’ll queue infra + SRE for the test.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: acme_rerank_ndcg_mrr_results.csv; rerank_eval_playbook.pdf; prompt_set_v1.jsonl
